observation.command:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get install -y -qq apache2 > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "apache install: $?"; a2enmod proxy proxy_http rewrite cgi 2>&1 | tail -1
# fix public URL in runtime mapfile
sed -i 's|http://127.0.0.1:8090|http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver|g' /opt/mapserver/run/*.map /opt/mapserver/run/*.txt
# CGI wrapper for mapserv
cat > /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=xplanbox
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=xplanbox
export AWS_REGION=eu-central-1
export AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_WITHOUT_PROTOCOL=127.0.0.1:9000
export AWS_HTTPS=NO
export AWS_VIRTUAL_HOSTING=NO
export XPLAN_S3_BUCKET_ATTACHMENTS=xplan-attachments
export XPLAN_MAPSERVER_ON_MISSING_DATA=TRUE
export XPLAN_SERVICES_WMS_MAXWIDTH=4096
export PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=5432 PGUSER=xplanbox PGPASSWORD=xplanbox PGDATABASE=xplanbox
export MS_MAP_FILE=/opt/mapserver/run/mapserver.map
case "$QUERY_STRING" in
  map=*) : ;;
  *) QUERY_STRING="map=/opt/mapserver/run/mapserver.map&$QUERY_STRING" ;;
esac
export QUERY_STRING
exec /usr/bin/mapserv
EOF
chmod +x /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper
# test wrapper
QUERY_STRING="request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1" REQUEST_METHOD=GET SERVER_PROTOCOL="HTTP/1.1" HTTP_HOST=localhost REMOTE_ADDR=127.0.0.1 timeout 30 /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper 2>&1 | head -c 300
